metadata.description: Serial small-dataset ablation, 3 datasets, 3 seeds and 3 repetitions per seed; fresh process per variant. Exact certificates computed after timed estimators. Baseline is user pre-change working tree, not necessarily git HEAD.
metadata.aggregation: Average of within-seed median estimator wall-clock times; report individual seeds to expose regressions.
notes: All solver threads fixed to one. Timing excludes imports, license startup warm-up, and independent certificates.
Projection-stage certificate gaps concern the dense projection objective, while info.objective/gap concern aggregation.
Changing separation oracle formulation changes the generated constraints and solution path. End-to-end ablations do not isolate root relaxation strength.
